topic.name: Impact of the Internet on Organisations & Society

subtopics.name: Impact of the Internet on Organisations
Impact of the Internet on Society

parts.problem_md:
Joe’s use of digital technologies has implications.

State **two **causes of the digital divide.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> Any two from:
> 
> - Poverty / cost
> - Social restrictions e.g. lack of education
> - Political restrictions e.g. government regulation
> - Lack of infrastructure e.g. network/power (on a national/regional scale)
> - Cultural restrictions e.g. religion

parts.problem_md:
The concert venue uses an online booking system.

Customers can store a digital ticket to their smartphone and access the venue by scanning their phone.

Explain why the venue must also provide customers with the option to print tickets.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> An explanation to include two from:
> 
> Some people do not have access to (some) technology (1), so this would limit their audience (1) and raise issues of inequity (1)

parts.problem_md:
The venue promotes events on a website.

Explain **one** global cause of unequal access to ICT.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> An explanation to include two from:
> 
> - Affordability (1) because of economic position of certain countries (1)
> - Lack of infrastructure (1) because of geographical restrictions (1)
> - No legal/ethical right to access (1) because of social/political/religious restrictions (1)

parts.problem_md:
The staff at the venue work online.

Explain **two** positive impacts the use of the Internet has on the venue.
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> Two explanations, each to include **two** linked points such as:
> 
> - Improved communication (1) because people can talk to each other using a range of tools / quicker to send messages / messaging can be grouped to allow teams to work more effectively (1)
> - Access to global markets and workforce (1) because people can access/work in their own language / culture / time zones (1)
> - Information can be better managed and used (1) because people can collaborate more easily / data can be organised and searched/filtered (1)
